detail.longDescription:
Watch your videos while parked. Score your drives. Review where you have been.
CarDash brings Cast, Drive, Widgets and Sounds together in one app. Play your own media on compatible CarPlay displays, review your trips and personalize your everyday car experience.

CAST: VIDEO FOR YOUR PARKED CAR
- Turn a charging stop or a parked break into time for your own videos.
- Add your own M3U or M3U8 IPTV playlist and browse its channels.
- Import local videos from Photos or Files.
- Start iPhone screen mirroring through the system Screen Broadcast control.
- Open websites in the built-in browser and send a page to a compatible car display.
- Save favorite channels, videos and websites for easier access.
- CarDash does not include TV channels, movies or streaming subscriptions. Bring content you have permission to use. Video output depends on your iPhone, iOS version, vehicle and content source. A CarPlay audio connection alone does not guarantee video support. Protected content and some websites may restrict playback or screen mirroring. Watch only while parked.

DRIVE: UNDERSTAND EVERY TRIP
- See how you drive with trip scores, route history and driving statistics.
- Record trips automatically after the required permissions are enabled.
- Review acceleration, braking and cornering.
- See distance, duration and speed statistics.
- Replay your route and explore the roads you have traveled.
- Build your personal territory map and share trip highlights.
- Choose miles or kilometers.

WIDGETS: MAKE IT YOURS
- Create a dashboard-inspired Home Screen that reflects your style.
- Choose vehicle and brand designs.
- Personalize photo, date, countdown and license plate widgets.
- Customize supported text, colors and decorative details.

SOUNDS: YOUR CAR'S PERSONALITY
Choose sounds for connecting, disconnecting or arriving. Follow the in-app setup guide to configure your automations.

FREE FEATURES AND PRO
Try Cast with a limited free car-playback allowance and one IPTV playlist source. Pro removes these Cast limits and unlocks additional premium features. Available plans and current prices are shown before purchase.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
